ops.title: #313 pictures call 10 - does the no-repeat action rule (a group header's action and a tile's action never repeat) still hold now the band inside the group (B) is the default? Dave's question
ops.closes_when: Dave says, in his words, whether the no-repeat rule holds under B (the band), holds only under A (on the wall), or is dropped; the answer is inscribed and template-dashboard-bento.meta.json $groupHeader.openForDave is rewritten to carry it
ops.body: Minted #313 lane V2. The page recommended A WITH the rule 'a group's action and a tile's own action never repeat'; Dave chose B by click (s313-D29) with the comment, verbatim: 'B as the default, A as an option for the designer', and said nothing about the rule. Lane N1nav recorded the question in the meta ($groupHeader.openForDave) and in its report but minted no row; the night brief names it as his (NIGHT-CONDUCTOR-BRIEF section 2, P-plan section 4). Nothing was decided.

ops.title: #313 pictures call 7 - the bottom-edge-only border was built on the mega menu, the account menu and the dropdown menus; does it also reach Popover, Tooltip and the nav rail's flyout, which float and still carry the edge on four sides? Dave's question
ops.closes_when: Dave says which floating surfaces the bottom-edge rule reaches; the ruling is inscribed and the named snippets are edited (or left) to match, then canon is regenerated
ops.body: Minted #313 lane V2. s313-D26 names 'the mega menu, the account menu, dropdowns' with his comment, verbatim: 'it needs an edge but only a bottom edge'. Lanes N1nav and N1nav-menus built it on exactly those (Navigations, Dropdown and nine menu snippets); Split-button's menu is still owed (B4 owned that file tonight). Popover, Tooltip and the rail flyout were not named by the call and were left on four sides; N1nav asked the question in its report without a row.

ops.title: #313 cohort-one call 5 - lane L4 took the table's `disabled` state out with `pressed`; the page's recommendation named pressed only. Keep disabled out, or put it back? Dave's question
ops.closes_when: Dave answers on the L4 re-look page (where the removal is flagged) or in chat; if he wants disabled kept it is one line in table.meta.json states and its $hand entry is reworded
ops.body: Minted #313 lane V2. s313-D4's recommendation, verbatim: 'take pressed out (it belongs to the demo switcher above the table, not the table)'. L4 also removed disabled because its only source was the same demo switcher (style .seg button:disabled), and flagged it on the re-look page as one step past his words. Not a defect; a decision that is his, recorded so it is not lost.
